get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying properties, associations, and archived status through query parameters. This endpoint supports pagination to navigate through large sets of objects.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

The `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. Provided property values will be overwritten, while read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where the keys are property names and the values are the corresponding property values. Each value is a string.

schema.description: Represents the input required to update a CRM object, containing an object with property names and their corresponding values.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether this object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this object, represented as a string.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A string used to trace the write operations on this object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their values, where each value is a string.

sourceId.description: A string identifier for the specific source of the value.

sourceLabel.description: A string label providing additional context or description for the source.

sourceType.description: A string indicating the type of source from which the value originates.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: An integer representing the ID of the user who last updated the value.

value.description: The actual value being recorded. It is represented as a string.

items.description: Property model that includes timestamp.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to an array of their historical values, each with a timestamp.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL of this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each containing a category, message, and context.

category.description: A string representing the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with properties as key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

message.description: A string containing the message that describes the warning.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between different object types, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding relationships between various CRM objects in your HubSpot account.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token used as a cursor to retrieve the next set of results in a paged response.

link.description: A string URL that points to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object contains details about the associated object and the labels applied to the association.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each containing details about the type and label of the association. Each item in the array is an object of type AssociationSpecWithLabel.

category.description: The category of the association, which can be 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', or 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID from which the association originates.

label.description: A string label that describes the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the object type ID to which the association points.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to which this object is associated. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
